budget.rationale: Measured at 192031 bytes on 2026-08-16 at the resolved data location; 1MiB leaves more than twice the observed SQLite database and sidecar footprint.

data.rationale: Resolved scenario data directory containing the SQLite ledger, account and goal state, audit records, and SQLite sidecars.

service.name: money-ledger
service.description: Accounts, money events, derived balances, and financial position

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o money-ledger-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

data-backup-manager.description: Protects the resolved Money Ledger data directory through scheduled snapshots and recovery drills; it is not part of request handling.
data-backup-manager.degraded_behavior: Money Ledger runs normally when the backup manager is unavailable; protection is a scheduled operational concern and is never substituted with synthetic financial values.

landing-page-business-suite.description: Planned P1 source for the commerce adapter (OT-P1-005): subscription and charge events, entering through the ordinary money-event contract rather than as a privileged integration. Disabled until that adapter is built.
landing-page-business-suite.degraded_behavior: The commerce adapter reports unavailable with its last-success age and does not advance its sync cursor, so the next run re-reads rather than skips. No zero-valued event is ever written, and position marks itself partial while the adapter is down.
